_readme: Seed data for MD Atlas. Prompts were compiled by automated research across aggregators, applicant forums, and school sites; every prompt carries the source URL it was read from. confirmed=true means the text was read on the school's own domain. truncated=true means the source itself cut the text off. Anything not confirmed must be checked against the school's own secondary before a student writes to it.

Describe a situation where you had to adjust your behavior or response based on new information or changing conditions.

Describe an experience that challenged the way you see the world. How did it influence your ability to understand others and meet them where they are?

Share an example where you took initiative to support others while putting their needs ahead of your own. Please share your connection to the state—or, if you do not have one, what draws you to care for patients here. We understand that an application may not fully capture everything that makes a candidate unique. We invite you to use this space to share something not already addressed in your primary or secondary application that you believe would help the Admissions Committee better understand you as an applicant. This may include gaps in your education, personal or academic achievements, or challenges you have overcome.

As part of our commitment to evaluating and strengthening our outreach efforts, we ask applicants to share any involvement in formal pipeline or preparatory programs hosted by the UA College of Medicine – Phoenix. Participation in these programs is not required and will not impact your application review. If you participated in any of the following—Summer Scrubs, Saturday Scrubs, Pre-Med Academy, Pre-Med Summer School, InstaMed, Cardiology Academy, or the Flinn Scholars program—please list each program and describe your role or level of involvement.
